stories.headline: Temporary disposable barbecue ban over wildfire risk
stories.description: The government warns that single-use grills pose a high risk in drought and heatwave conditions.

stories.headline: Wall Street week ahead: Home Depot and Walmart report earnings, minutes of Fed meeting are released
stories.description: Wall Street awaits earnings from major retailers and minutes from the Federal Reserve this week.

stories.headline: Europe's scorched landscapes seen from space after summer heatwaves
stories.description: BBC Verify examines the impact of drought and extreme heat on western European rivers, fields and mountains.

stories.headline: FIFA’s Infantino gets Giuliani backing in World Cup selloff fallout
stories.description: Andrew Giuliani, son of ex-New York Mayor Rudy Giuliani, tells critics of FIFA’s Gianni Infantino ‘it’s just politics’.

stories.headline: Israeli strike kills seven in south Lebanon as attacks intensify
stories.description: Deadliest Israeli attack in Lebanon since June agreements significantly reduced hostilities.
